forensics.assessment: Standard commercial spec sheet. No covert payloads. Clean.

security.default_password_mandate: 3.10.30+ forces password change on first login
security.brute_force_protection: Added in 3.30.18 for IoT Connector REST interface

data_interfaces.claas_kafka: Streams tag ID + location estimates via KAFKA

cve_2024_6387.description: OpenSSH regreSSHion — signal handler race condition enabling unauthenticated remote code execution
cve_2024_6387.exploitability: Network-accessible SSH on pre-patch devices = trivial RCE

llrp_exposure.description: EPCglobal LLRP v1.0.1 has no authentication in base spec. Reader reconfiguration possible if not in secure mode.
llrp_exposure.impact: Tag data interception, reader misconfiguration, denial of service

iot_connector_leakage.description: CLAS Location Analytics streams real-time tag locations via KAFKA. IoT Connector pushes to cloud MQTT endpoints.
iot_connector_leakage.impact: Real-time personnel/asset tracking data exfiltration if endpoint compromised

web_console_weaknesses.description: Apache 2.4.63 + Node.js pages. Self-signed cert warnings are documented as 'false alarms' in release notes, conditioning admins to ignore TLS errors.
web_console_weaknesses.impact: Credential theft, admin session hijacking, firmware manipulation

poe_attack_surface.description: PoE+ 802.3at means power and data share the same Ethernet cable. No physical network isolation.
poe_attack_surface.impact: Switch compromise = reader compromise. VLAN hopping possible.

confirmed_sectors: Military & Department of Defense (confirmed on zebra.com product page)
Airport baggage handling (inferred from RTLS use cases)
Correctional facilities (inferred from 'worker tracking' and 'loss prevention' language)
covert_applications: Overhead personnel tracking via passive UHF tags in badges/footwear
Direction-of-movement analysis for corridor/doorway transit detection
Real-time location streaming to external analytics (KAFKA)
Asset tracking in sensitive facilities without battery maintenance (passive tags <$0.08)
